kinds.a: outdoor key box · key lock box · キーボックス
kinds.d: A small lockable box, usually wall-mounted outside, that holds a spare door key behind a code.
A lockable wall cabinet fitted with hooks or tags for storing many keys indoors.
A box fixed to a wall, post or through a wall that receives letters and small post.

kinds.a: parcel drop box · package box · delivery box
kinds.d: A larger lockable box that lets couriers leave parcels securely when nobody is home.

notes: Key safe: cut 15 SKUs to 6, one per market-covering brand, police-approved grades first (Abus 787, Supra 001409 — the C500 reference, to verify — Burton Keyguard XL), then Master Lock 5415, Squire Key Keep, Yale Y500. Dropped Abus 707/767/797 and Squire Key Keep 2 as same-range size variants, Master Lock 5425 (dial variant now a type), Lockey LKS500 and Supra Slim Line/111S7 as redundant, and Supra/Kidde over-the-door portable (now the 'over-door' type). Key cabinet: kept as a stub with no models; the single Decayeux SKU was a one-shop item. Letterbox: kept both US brands as market-covering; mounting and locking variants moved to types. Parcel box: dropped Mail Boss Mail Manager Street Safe (letterbox near-duplicate) and Post & Porch Malone (small brand, single SKU); kept Package Master, Centennial and the Oasis range. No archetypes, kinds or brand entries added; old source URLs retained.
